title: Air Force lieutenant colonel ran ARV test program at Edwards 412th Test Wing
place_text: Edwards Air Force Base; Nevada Test and Training Range

tellings.quote: I'm familiar with a Air Force Lieutenant Colonel out there who claims to have run a um a program that was focused on testing alien reproduction vehicles and derivative technology.

plain: An Air Force lieutenant colonel says he ran a programme between about 1998 and 2008 that tested "alien reproduction vehicles", craft built by copying alien technology, along with technology derived from them. The work is said to have taken place with the flight-test wing at Edwards Air Force Base and over the Nevada test ranges. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels he knows the officer, and he passes on the officer's claim without naming him.
